## Definitions

- [statement] showDebugQueryShape is an optional boolean that defaults to false. Setting it to true requests debugQueryShape; the manual example replaces a date literal with the placeholder ?date. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection

## How it works

- [statement] Inspect explain output to verify settings attached to a particular query. MongoDB source appends nonempty querySettings to queryPlanner and sets indexFilterSet to false when those settings are present. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/query/explain.cpp
- [statement] Percona ClusterSync documents manual export with $querySettings because it does not automatically migrate persistent query settings. Its procedure applies to source and destination clusters running MongoDB 8.0 or later. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-13) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Run db.aggregate([{ $querySettings: {} }]) to inspect stored entries. Output includes queryShapeHash and settings; representativeQuery can also be present. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html
- [statement] Run db.aggregate([{ $querySettings: {} }]) to inspect defined settings. The documented output includes queryShapeHash and settings; Percona uses this command to export settings for migration. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] SERVER-116447 tracks exposing applied settings in currentOp and slow query logs. The cached ticket is Fixed, lists 9.1.0-rc0 and 9.1.0-rc1024 as fix versions, and requests a v9.0 backport; it does not establish that a 9.0 backport shipped. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-19) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-116447 · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection
- [statement] The settings comment appears in $querySettings output, explain output, and slow query logs. MongoDB documents comment support starting in 8.1 and 8.0.4. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysettings/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] If an aggregation has additional stages, $querySettings must be its first stage. The manual uses database-level db.aggregate rather than a collection aggregation. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Introduced in MongoDB 8.0, $querySettings returns settings previously added with setQuerySettings; stored settings apply cluster-wide and survive restarts. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysettings/, https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html
- [statement] An allowedIndexes entry in inspected settings does not prove the winning plan used an index: MongoDB documents that the planner may still choose a collection scan. Check the actual explain plan. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection
- [statement] For hash-created settings, representativeQuery is initially absent. Starting with MongoDB 8.3 and FCV 8.3 or later, a matching query schedules asynchronous, best-effort backfill; the first matching execution need not complete it. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection
- [statement] NoSQLBooster 11.2 documents the fluent inspection helper db.aggregate().querySettings({ showDebugQueryShape: true }). This is client-specific syntax; the server stage remains $querySettings. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-2/ · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md
- [statement] For resumable-index-build research, treat $querySettings as query-planning configuration context: the documented output describes stored query shapes and settings, not index-build progress or resume state. This scope conclusion is an inference from the documented interface. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection
- [statement] Do not assume every settings entry has representativeQuery. Settings created using a query-shape hash initially omit it, and Percona explicitly handles exported entries without that field. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html
- [statement] The MongoDB stage reference lists Atlas, Enterprise, and Community compatibility, but explicitly excludes Atlas M0 and Flex clusters. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/querySettings.md · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysettings/
- [statement] Percona ClusterSync documentation says persistent query settings require manual migration after replication is finalized; its procedure exports them with $querySettings and reapplies them with setQuerySettings. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-13) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html · keywords: $querySettings stage and query settings inspection
